title: Where the lifeboats go: five years of RNLI launches mapped
excerpt: I looked at all 45,673 RNLI lifeboat launches from 2021 to 2025. Half went less than 4.5 km from the station, summer belongs to leisure boats, and the busiest station of all is on the Thames.
seo_description: 45,673 RNLI lifeboat launches mapped: how far the boats go, for whom and when, 2021 to 2025.
